purpose: Define the runnable diagnostic-export checks that the current operator-v1 candidate must satisfy before the repo can honestly say implementation scaffolding exists while accepted delta_uet_or_ci remains missing.

required_execution_checks.requirement: The target module exists and exposes the required entrypoint plus return key.
Running the target module through the primary verifier writes the residual artifact and returns the operator gate.
The emitted residual-row count matches the current same-source-family helium holdout prediction count.
Every emitted residual row includes the required uncertainty fields, including uncertainty_computable.
Every emitted residual row remains diagnostic-only and does not relabel the current emitter as delta_uet_or_ci.
The current execution state stays aligned with the candidate implementation review record for the selected operator class.

blocked_claims: candidate execution readiness means an accepted delta_uet_or_ci operator exists
diagnostic residual rows with uncertainty fields are validation-ready thresholds
a runnable exporter may be treated as a correlated two-electron or explicit UET correction operator before accepted provenance exists
claim_boundary: This manifest narrows implementation missing into runnable candidate-export checks only. It does not accept or validate a correction operator.
